I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The 4 existing tests pass. I didn't add a test for the new setting.

It is read from `ledger.toml` like `db_path` and `rates_url`, so `currency = "EUR"` there overrides the default. `load()` already picks up any known field, so it needed no change.

I did not add a `LEDGER_CURRENCY` environment override. A saved project note says every setting should have a `LEDGER_<NAME>` override. But `config.py` has a `# Rule:` comment saying Config is read from `ledger.toml` only, with no environment-variable overrides. The comment describes the code as it is now, so I followed it. "The same way as the other settings" also points at `ledger.toml`.

If you do want env overrides, that's a separate change: update the rule and `load()` together, for all settings.
